answer: Counterparty diversity threshold stops bulk fake identities: a new identity must trade with 12 counterparties in 10 epochs, its graph fans out like a river delta, not one narrow stream. Fakes trading only among themselves are flagged as a closed loop, while honest agents cross the ocean via the harbor. Renting 12 partners costs $5 each, $60 per fake; 1,000 fakes cost $60,000 vs a $3,000 pool. Honest agents pay nothing and keep their full share.
